name: Eternal Wellspring
tagline: The Word of God - Your only Way to the Tree of Life
description:
The Bible’s story is larger than most of us are aware. This website presents biblical concepts that are rarely covered in 20 minutes from a pulpit. A common approach for this site's topics is, 'What has the whole bible has to say?'

When you have a  greater appreciation of God's intentions, verses that once passed you by, begin to fall into place.  While there are hundreds of supporting scriptures for these topics, you only need to read those for unfamiliar concepts - and every scripture is just one click away.  

This means bible studies can cover familiar ground quickly and slow down for deeper biblical insights into unfamiliar concepts. 

This is a Wellspring of God's eternal Word: God's purpose has not changed since before creation — to dwell with a human family on the earth forever. The Cross opens the way; however the story is not finished until God lives with His people on earth as it was with Adam and Eve, but without knowledge of good and evil forever!

Choose the topic, read the story, study the Word: drink from God's wellspring of life...
